name: Nakasugawa Satomi
source:
A third year high school student who become a vice-president student council. She works well in her studies and her sports too. A lot of student admire her as she is a kind and beautiful girl in her school. [url=/c1066]Akito[/url] is also no exception; he admires her very much. 

[Roughly translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=66661]Getchu's website[/url].]
